panels.description: Sitara holds a field tablet over Falcon maintenance records while her separate TJ scans selected pages. Nayah watches the ceiling as frost shakes loose. Leave upper-right and lower-left clear.
Sitara overlays the drilling trace and ice-motion plot; the red line shows local acceleration without implying Falcon causes the whole Antarctic crisis. Leave upper-left clear.
A warning light flashes and meltwater beads along the threshold. Nayah pulls the emergency line taut toward the exit while Sitara closes the tablet. Leave upper-left and upper-right clear.
The copied record shows NEXUS — ROUTE 2 — SECOND TIMESTAMP and PAIR BEFORE DISCLOSURE. Keep the coordinate legible with the rest quiet.

items.speaker: SITARA
items.text: Then the copy has to be complete.
